text: Pipeline source files for nova keymgr/limit/servicegroup are in New-repo-test; KB records live under .aee/kb/ at repo root; docs go to docs/src/<relative-path>.md

In this pipeline, source files are not checked out in the working tree; analysis relies on KB records (.aee/kb/), pipeline artifacts (candidates.json, coverage.json), and scanner output — direct file reads of src/ will fail.
aee-artifact path <name> only resolves registered artifact names; files in .aee/ present on disk but not in artifacts.jsonl are not reachable by name — read them directly from the filesystem

The security reviewer pipeline uses test-repo issue #3 for keymgr+limit+servicegroup batch coordination; security:analysis-ready signals the reviewer, security:approved wakes cross_file_security_correlator.
